title: C4OS Grill Question 005 - Plugin Configuration Scope

questions.label: Where should C4OS app plugin enablement live by default?
questions.help: Recommended: layered config with user defaults and workspace overrides. This lets the app install ship plugins disabled, lets a user opt into preferred plugins globally, and lets a workspace narrow or override plugin behavior.
options: Layered: user defaults with workspace overrides

questions.label: Where should panel side, icon order, and hidden/visible view config live?
questions.help: Recommended: same layered config as enablement, with session state only tracking which panels are currently open.
options: Layered config for preferences; session state for currently open panels

questions.label: Notes or corrections
questions.help: Clarify whether config should be stored under ~/.c4os, workspace descriptor files, project config, or another app-owned location.
